audit.definition: Climactic Mazama bulk airborne fallout, including co-ignimbrite ash. Both endpoints of an eligible complete-bed range enter as one interval event. Primary-coded Buckland observations with a local quantity enter by default, subject to documented site exceptions.

buffer_rule.uses: Coordinates and observation kinds only; never thickness values.

contours.display_rule: Exact sites bracket the level at distinct vertices and at least 90% of draws cross it in this triangle. Display only.

peaks.rule: Original mapped maximum, vent, all accepted sites and triangle vertices, plus 49 radii and 128 bearings inside the nearest accepted radius. Finite search on 512 posterior fields.

unobserved_proximal_cap.assumption: Add the positive part of background-minus-local source thickness with a cubed parabolic taper to the nearest accepted site. One universal unobserved proximal scenario.
